# LiDAR

## Hardware

Our second major piece of new hardware was the VL53L0X ToF sensors, which use LiDAR to read distances of up to 2 meters. 

We used the HiLetGo breakout boards from Amazon, which nicely housed the VL53L0Xs, and allowed us to easily connect to the pin, including the I2C SCK, SDA, and XSHUT pins, as well as the Vcc and GND pins. We used I2C to communicate with the sensors. 

We did frequently run into issues with the continued operation of the VL53L0X sensors– they proved fairly temperamental and frequently returned errors indicating difficulty reading the return signal. We weren’t sure if this was due to the light conditions of the lab, but they persisted even in other spaces. However, we purchased extras in case of this occurring, allowing us to continue our work. 


## I2C

The VL53L0X sensors use I2C protocol to communicate. Thus, we had to use the I2C peripherals present on the STM32L432KC MCU. We wrote init_i2c1() , read_i2c1(), and write_i2c2() functions, which were enough to accomplish what we needed. We hadn’t used the I2C peripherals previously in the course, so we were able to gain a good understanding through this project. 

Through our research, we found a git repository (found here [INSERT LINK HERE]) that contained a great deal of code for the VL53L0X sensors, by [INSERT NAME HERE]. This was adapted from the provided API for the VL53L0X. Using this code was incredibly useful, as many of the initialization functions and setting functions involve writing many values to many registers. 

We initially tried to use the API, as suggested by the user manual, but it proved difficult to adapt to our uses and space limitations. Since we were using pretty simple commands, we were able to much more easily adapt the code as mentioned above. 

Upon startup, each sensor had to be initialized, then its individual address set (using the XSHUT pin), to allow for multiple sensors to be used at once. Then, we simply had to command the sensor to measure a distance and send us the data every time a new round was started.
